lore.description: Colossal hydrogen jellyfish that travel in free-floating herds across Saiphus's lower atmosphere, the Neph are instrumental to the Benthane industry. These domesticated creatures roam the clouds in flocks, grazing off of the biochemicals and atmospheric plankton contained in the gas-liquid slush of Saiphus's deeper atmosphere using long, trailing tentacles that vacuum up valuable Benthane along with their food. When threatened, these same tentacles can be used to pull in opponents with considerable suction or to jettison air at high pressure. Neph can also forcibly expel jets of Benthane gas, which is typically used a coolant for starship engines, from their tentacles in order to blast their enemies with freezing air. Finally, being composed almost entirely hydrogen means that the Neph can also spray their enemies with bouts of flammable gas.
appearance: Colossal hydrogen jellyfish, huge but nearly weightless
Long trailing hollow tentacles, open at the ends
Small central body beneath the bell
lore.habits: It travels in herd distribution rather than alone, and its amorphous form lets the hurricane-force winds of the lower skies sweep it up and set it down again unharmed. The tentacles do the work. They draw the slush of the deeper atmosphere up hollow tubes and keep the Benthane that comes up with the food, and the same tubes reverse to pull a thing in against its will, to put it off at pressure, or to blast it cold with the coolant. Being almost entirely hydrogen, it can spray flammable gas as well. For what that filtering leaves behind it is shepherded, herded and milked. What kills it is the sky it lives in, sulfuric cloud contact and island collision.
lore.biomeNiche: the cloud layers of Saiphus's lower atmosphere, where Benthane plumes rise

signatureAbility.name: Benthane Coldwind
signatureAbility.description: The Neph forces the coolant gas banked in its tentacles out through their open ends, washing everything before it in a freezing white plume.
